data.one_liner: Command-line client for FlutterFlow to export code and build apps with AI.
data.what_it_does: The FlutterFlow CLI allows developers to export code from FlutterFlow projects, deploy Firebase configurations, and use FlutterFlow AI to build and edit applications declaratively from the terminal using an MCP server for coding agents.
use_when: You want to export your FlutterFlow project code directly into your local editor.
You want coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor to build and edit your FlutterFlow app declaratively.
You need to deploy your FlutterFlow project's Firebase configuration from the command line.
avoid_when: You are building a standard Flutter app without using FlutterFlow.
You need a general-purpose local state management or utility library for standard Flutter apps.
strengths: Direct integration with FlutterFlow projects and export workflows.
Built-in AI workspace support with MCP server integration for assistants like Claude Code and Cursor.
weaknesses: Requires a FlutterFlow account and API token.
Subject to strict licensing constraints under the Business Source License 1.1.
data.setup_notes: Activate globally using `dart pub global activate flutterflow_cli` and set your `FLUTTERFLOW_API_TOKEN` environment variable.
data.minimal_example:
dart pub global activate flutterflow_cli
export FLUTTERFLOW_API_TOKEN=<your token>
flutterflow export-code --project <project id> --dest <output folder>
